# ZXing browser decoder

Bundled from `@zxing/browser` version 0.2.1 (`umd/zxing-browser.min.js`).

- Source: https://github.com/zxing-js/browser
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zxing/browser
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE` in this directory.

The file is packaged with the extension so barcode recognition runs locally and remains compatible with Chrome Manifest V3's remote-code restrictions.
